exposure: previous history of preeclampsia and FGR
uterine artery doppler examination at 21-24 weeks
uterine artery doppler examination at 11-13 weeks
no previous history of preeclampsia and FGR
cohort: 100 women with singleton pregnancies between 11 to 13 weeks of gestation.
finding: The study found a higher incidence of preeclampsia, FGR, preterm delivery, NICU admission, and neonatal death in the group with previous history of preeclampsia and FGR and abnormal doppler findings compared to those without previous history.
